title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ojt7: fragments_in_window_vec calls renamed method fragments_in_window
description:
In rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs (std_ext module, line 1014):
fragments_in_window_vec() helper calls self.fragments_in_window(abs_window).collect() but the method was renamed. The helper itself IS the renamed version, creating a recursive/infinite loop at worst, or simply calling a method that no longer exists.

Fix: change the implementation to use the actual underlying iterator/logic that fragments_in_window used to provide.
